payload.title: File:Barosize.svg
payload.description_html:
Size of the North American Upper Jurassic diplodocid sauropod Barosaurus lentus, scaled to specimen AMNH 6341. The human silhouette is from File:Silhouette of man standing and facing forward.svg (CC0).

References

  • Barosaurus skeletal diagram by Scott Hartman
  • McIntosh, John S. (2005) "The genus Barosaurus Marsh (Sauropoda, Diplodocidae)" in Tidwell, Virginia, ed. Thunder-lizards: The Sauropod Dinosaurs, Bloomington: Indiana University Press, pp. 38–77 ISBN: 978-0-253-34542-4.
  • Tschopp, Emanuel; Mateus, Octávio (2013). "The skull and neck of a new flagellicaudatan sauropod from the Morrison Formation and its implication for the evolution and ontogeny of diplodocid dinosaurs". Journal of Systematic Palaeontology 11 (7): 853-888.
